data.name: Durvisha
data.long_meaning: Durvisha is derived from the Sanskrit root 'dur' meaning 'difficulty, obstacle, challenge' and the suffix 'visha' meaning 'poison'. In Hindu mythology, Durvasha was the name of a sage who cursed King Janaka, leading to the birth of Sita, the wife of Lord Rama. The name symbolizes the idea of overcoming obstacles with wisdom and courage.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of wisdom and courage to overcome challenges and obstacles.
